## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: mixed sector leadership (Energy/Utilities/Financials ABOVE TREND vs Technology and Consumer Discretionary lagging) and major divergence across several large names (MSFT, V, MA, ADBE showing 1W vs 1M mismatch); Leadership concentrated (Top 5 span 3 sectors).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +30.31%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +22.35%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +3.66%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities strong: VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND. Financials mixed but positive on the week: JPM (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Industrials lag: UNP (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -9.32%) BELOW TREND. Communication weak: TTWO (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary showing pressure: BKNG (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership concentrated (Top 5 span 3 sectors).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: UNP (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -9.32%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -6.42% | 1M: +11.81%) CORRECTION, MNST (1W: -6.49% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in Industrials and select high-multiple names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND — watch INTC RECOVERY and multiple CORRECTION reads (MSFT/V/MA/ADBE) as divergences.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed with concentrated winners but internal stress: NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +2.51%) ABOVE TREND while MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) is in CORRECTION and GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND; Technology showing mixed internals and rotational flows.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are modestly positive on the week with dispersion: JPM (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -1.71% | 1M: +1.43%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -2.70% | 1M: +0.57%) CORRECTION — breadth supportive but payment names show short-term weakness.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare holding steady with split leadership: JNJ (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +7.63%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +8.59%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -1.69%) RECOVERY versus LLY (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -3.43%) BELOW TREND — defensive pocket resilience amid rotation.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Energy and Utilities exposure (MPC (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +30.31%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +22.35%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to lagging Consumer Discretionary and select Technology names showing CORRECTION or BELOW TREND (AMZN (1W: -2.97% | 1M: -5.05%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND); style: mixed / no clear leadership, monitor divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +30.31%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: PANW (1W: -10.32% | 1M: -7.30%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -2.97% | 1M: -5.05%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.76% | 1M: +13.73%) and Utilities (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +0.81%). BEARISH: Technology (1W: -0.70% | 1M: +2.14%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -5.15%).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through on weekly strength; monitor MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) in CORRECTION — failure to regain 1W positive would deepen the pullback; a renewed move above recent 1M gains for MPC (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +30.31%) would confirm Energy leadership; break below this week’s lows in UNP (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND would reinforce Industrial weakness.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
INTC (+60): ASML next‑gen chipmaking lead headline; INTC (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY — price shows short‑term confirmation but 1M lag remains. LMT (+60): HIMARS win headline; LMT (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -9.32%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging from price, watch for fundamental follow‑through. WMT (+55): $2.9B windfall headline; WMT (1W: +3.93% | 1M: -4.17%) RECOVERY — price partially confirms news but 1M weakness persists. CAT (+60): backlog/news supportive; CAT (1W: +1.71% | 1M: -5.02%) RECOVERY — short‑term lift versus 1M drag.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
BA (-55): fatal crash coverage; BA (1W: +1.16% | 1M: -8.59%) RECOVERY — price showing short bounce but sentiment and 1M weakness remain a risk. AMZN (-45): inquiry coverage; AMZN (1W: -2.97% | 1M: -5.05%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirms price weakness. META (-45): headline about warnings; META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines but price currently confirming strength (divergence to monitor). PLTR (-45): same headline; PLTR (1W: -6.42% | 1M: +11.81%) CORRECTION — news aligns with 1W weakness versus 1M strength.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND and Energy names MPC (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +30.31%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk: major short‑term divergences in MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -1.71% | 1M: +1.43%) CORRECTION and mixed news flow on LMT/INTC require monitoring.
